name: Trial of Strength
description: Ordeal of the monument testing power, instincts and survival skills.

timeline.summary: Rhonas's Trial of Strength: initiates climb thorny vines, lose spellcasting to a toxin and must claim a basilisk's scale for the cure.
timeline.quote: Initiates had to climb thorny vines and ride down a raging waterfall.

timeline.summary: Initiates climb the Stairs of Rhonas and leap down the waterfall into the jungle.
timeline.quote: a climb up the treacherous Stairs of Rhonas , followed by a leap of faith to ride the thundering waterfall down into the jungle below

timeline.summary: Initiates must claim a scale from the basilisk as a cure, then return to Rhonas, who bestows the cartouche of strength.
timeline.quote: The final test demands that the initiate claim a single scale from the basilisk
